prerequisite.title: Toy workspace
prerequisite.detail: An empty fictional project folder is available.

prerequisite.title: Paper-town blueprint
prerequisite.detail: The pretend scene template has been supplied.

prerequisite.title: Color palette
prerequisite.detail: A sample set of imaginary colors is available.

prerequisite.title: Sample tiles
prerequisite.detail: Three fictional map tiles have been prepared.

guide.title: Build a paper town
guide.summary: Assemble an imaginary town from a blueprint, then render a miniature preview. An older CLI meets a newer scene format.

steps.title: Prepare the town scene
steps.detail: The scene builder needs an empty workspace and the paper-town blueprint.

steps.title: Render a miniature preview
steps.detail: The preview format is supported by Loom Engine v2 and v3.

steps.title: Review the pretend skyline
steps.detail: Review the preview in this imaginary workflow. No files are created here.

guide.title: Light a lantern garden
guide.summary: Add imaginary lanterns to a miniature garden. Check the palette first and keep the kit on a compatible release.

steps.title: Create the garden layout
steps.detail: An empty toy workspace supplies the starting surface.

steps.title: Choose the lantern colors
steps.detail: The color palette and a valid layout are both needed before the lanterns can be arranged.

steps.title: Preview the lantern garden
steps.detail: An earlier successful step must have produced the lit garden.

guide.title: Stitch a pocket atlas
guide.summary: Combine fictional tiles into a pocket-sized map. Skip an earlier step to see why downstream outputs disappear.

steps.title: Arrange the sample tiles
steps.detail: The workspace and sample tiles form an ordered imaginary map.

steps.title: Stitch the atlas pages
steps.detail: This atlas format needs Loom Engine v3 or v4.

steps.title: Preview the pocket atlas
steps.detail: The preview consumes atlas pages from the stitching step.
